channels.name: ego_speed_mps
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)
channels.uncertainty: engine velocity; no sensor noise model

channels.name: lead_speed_mps
channels.method: Native actor.get_velocity magnitude of the control (lead) vehicle each tick
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)

channels.name: bumper_gap_m
channels.method: Road-frame distance from lead rear to ego front while the lead is ahead in the ego lane; -1 when none
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)
channels.uncertainty: nominal bounding-box length; straight road so s equals x

channels.name: ego_lane_id
channels.method: Native waypoint lane_id readback at ego location
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)
channels.uncertainty: lane assignment by native map projection

context_inputs.name: surface_context
context_inputs.method: authored world setup plus native readback (wetness, friction, grade, crest, public-way declaration)

limitations: Reasonable and prudent following distance is a legal judgment and is not measured.
Public-way status is an authored declaration of a synthetic road.
Tire friction is an engine setting, not a measured real-world coefficient.

cameras.name: overview
cameras.pose_strategy: airborne chase of the ego/lead midpoint, 45 m up, pitched 60 degrees down

cameras.name: approach
cameras.pose_strategy: trailing 12 m behind and 3.2 m above ego, looking forward

cameras.name: reference_corner
cameras.pose_strategy: right-side corner view 12 m beside ego, aimed at the vehicles

cameras.name: driver_reference
cameras.pose_strategy: driver eye point in ego cabin, forward
